table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	srledger.srinvcode,   
	srledger.srcatcode,   
	srledger.date,   
	srledger.remarks,   
	srledger.custcode,   
	srledger.salesmancode,   
	srledger.discperc,   
	srledger.flatdisc,
	srledger.invgstperc1,   
	users.username,   
	srledger.misccharges,   
	srledger.posted,   
	srledger.postdate, 
	srledger.saleinvcode,
	srledger.originaldate,
	srledger.modifiedby,
	srledger.postedby,
	srledger.custrefno,
	custname ='Retail Sale Customer                                ',
	srledger.smancode,
	srledger.invtotal,
	srledger.machinename,
	gcode=0,
	srledger.headerno,
	srledger.headerinvno,
	regno=space(60),
	aliasname=(SELECT accounts.aliasname FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode = srledger.custcode),
	srledger.patientcode,
	srledger.admissioncode,
	GuestRegNo=(SELECT G.RegNo FROM Guest G WHERE G.GuestCode=SrLedger.GuestCode),
	SrLedger.GuestCode,
	SrLedger.GuestCheckInCode,
	GuestBalance=0.00,
	StudentRegNo=(SELECT ST.RegNo FROM Student ST WHERE ST.StudentCode=SrLedger.StudentCode),
	SrLedger.StudentCode,
	StudentBalance=0.00,
	ChasisNo=(SELECT MV.ChasisNo FROM MotorVehicle MV WHERE MV.MotorVehicleCode=Srledger.MotorVehicleCode),
	Srledger.MotorVehicleCode,
	address=space(60),
	phone=space(100),
	city=space(60),
	Srledger.AccountFor,
	Srledger.PaymentMode,
	Srledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Srledger.Amt,
	Srledger.AmtBy,
	Srledger.AmtDate,
	Srledger.AmtReference,
	Srledger.Outstandingamt,
	Srledger.marked,
	Srledger.pagesize,
	Srledger.ConsiderInPO,
	srledger.CashAccCode,
	srledger.CashTendered,
	srledger.CashCharged,
	srledger.CashBack,
	srledger.CurrencyCode,
	srledger.ConversionRate,
	srledger.AdvanceTax,
	srledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	srledger.FBRPOSFee,
	srledger.cashiershiftcode,
	srledger.sitecode,
	srledger.targetsitecode
FROM
	srledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan ON (srledger.smancode = salesman.salesmancode),
	users

WHERE 
	(srledger.salesmancode = users.usercode) and 
	(dbo.srledger.srinvcode = :ra_saleretinvcode)
